scope: filename naming design, including title conversion and suffix policies; not runtime configuration
fallback: Computer proposes character-name notation, then a known Unicode code point if a reliable name is unavailable, then a numbered unknown-symbol placeholder if both are unidentified. Present the complete final filename and all changes for user review before application. No intermediate confirmation prompts. Do not invent scientific meaning or code points.
length_policy: When actual destination limits require shortening, generate a sufficiently shortened candidate with the exact marker shortend-file as the last token within the existing other-details field, after any collision suffix and before the extension. Validate the full candidate and path; obtain final-proposal approval before application. Preserve the original full title and exception reason; never silently truncate.

policy_profile.portability: conservative portability selected by user; detailed coverage and validation remain to be specified
policy_profile.diagnostic_comparison_key: optional NFC; never substitute for original

processing_order: collect original fields and source evidence
apply field rules once with pinned mapping revision
show conversion and obtain exact-candidate approval

special_cases.action: show escaped characters and source evidence; no silent deletion
preserve structured notation; request reviewed filename representation
Preserve a known code point where available; if both name and code point are unidentified, propose a numbered unknown-symbol placeholder with source evidence and mandatory user confirmation.
do not overwrite; propose reviewed disambiguation
Propose sufficiently shortened name with shortend-file last in other-details; validate complete path and obtain final-proposal approval.

design_examples.condition: approved portability policy or target restriction

design_examples.note: literal token; check collisions, do not decode

design_examples.input_description: Source symbol with unidentified name and code point
design_examples.note: Record source location/image and preserve the original title; placeholder does not resolve scientific content.

order: explicit Unicode code-point token, e.g. [U+002F], if a reliable name representation is unavailable
numbered unresolved-symbol placeholder, e.g. [unknown-symbol-01], if both are unidentified
fallback_precedence.note: Computer selects levels automatically. User confirms the complete final filename proposal, not intermediate steps or individual characters. Preserve directly representable scientific notation.

unresolved_symbol_policy.meaning: Unidentified notation, not a resolved scientific interpretation.
unresolved_symbol_policy.numbering_details: Scope, allocation and revision stability remain to be specified; preserve distinct unresolved occurrences and their source mappings.

confirmation_policy.display: original title, complete proposed filename, all conversions, selected fallback levels and reasons

filename_structure.note: Replace spaces between words; do not rewrite scientific minus signs or existing meaningful notation. Final proposal confirmation still applies.

collision_policy.placement: within other-details, before shortend-file if present; otherwise last
collision_policy.meaning: filename collision discriminator, not publication/preprint version or execution revision

shortening_policy.marker_position: last token within other-details, after collision suffix, before extension; not a separate field

topic_suffix_policy.author: LLM proposes; user can edit
topic_suffix_policy.basis: source-grounded subject/category at paper keyword specificity
topic_suffix_policy.brevity: as short as practical; no numeric cap selected
order: shortend-file only when shortening is needed
